answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk forgery. To claim one work slot, an agent burns a 25 POA deposit and stamps it with a non-transferable onyx seal. A raven patrols the slots: only agents doing real work keep their slot; idle fakes lose theirs. A jade token marks a slot held honestly for a full epoch. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 25 = 2,500 POA against a ~900 POA pool. An honest agent burns once, keeps its slot, and earns an undiluted share.
